subject: gk
question: The idea of __________ has been borrowed from the Constitution of erstwhile USSR (Union of Soviet Socialist Republics).

options.text: Both Fundamental Duties and Fundamental Rights

solution:
The correct answer is** __Fundamental Duties__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The concept of **Fundamental Duties** was borrowed from the **Constitution of the erstwhile USSR**.
 
• These duties were added to the Indian Constitution by the **42nd Amendment Act, 1976**.
 
• **Article 51A** of the Indian Constitution lists the Fundamental Duties.
 
• There are **11 Fundamental Duties** listed in the Constitution.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Fundamental Rights** in the Indian Constitution were inspired by the **Bill of Rights** in the US Constitution.
 
• The **Preamble** of the Indian Constitution was influenced by the **Objectives Resolution** drafted by Jawaharlal Nehru.
 
• The **42nd Amendment Act** is also known as the **“Mini-Constitution”** due to its extensive changes to the Constitution.
